items.quote: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?
items.claim: In the text (verse 22:7), Isaac speaks to his father Abraham and asks where the lamb for the burnt offering is, since the fire and the wood are there.
items.action: asks where the lamb for the burnt offering is

items.quote: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.
items.claim: In the text (verse 22:8), Abraham answers that God will provide a lamb for the burnt offering, and the two of them go on together.
items.action: says God will provide the lamb; goes on with Isaac
items.mechanism: God providing the offering, as Abraham states it
